title: Return a data object
summary: ASP.NET Core: Return a data object. Add an author field.
introduction: Results.Json sends structured data as JSON. Open GET /book. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Return a data object with ASP.NET Core

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Run dotnet new web -n School, enter School, and replace Program.cs with one example. Run dotnet run --urls http://127.0.0.1:8000. Stop the app before changing examples.

blocks.title: Return a data object

blocks.text: Results.Json serialises the anonymous object with the named fields.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use objects for data instead of joining JSON text by hand.
